verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework, so first-party form building and validation modules are a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents a forms or validation module. The nearby items cover other things: preserving form state during stylesheet hot reload, vendored UI components like buttons, compile-time template validation, and typed props.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use first-party modules for building and validating forms that integrate with the rest of the framework
